how.title: How GramCity Express works
how.subtitle: One account can send, receive, and carry — pick what you need for each parcel.
sendSteps: Choose origin, destination, and handover points.
Describe your parcel — category, weight, and size.
Add receiver details or mark yourself as the receiver.
Browse matching trips and request delivery.
Review the quote, confirm, and hand over at the agreed time.
receiveSteps: See incoming parcels on your Receiving tab.
Acknowledge the shipment and confirm when you are available.
Meet at the handover point or request a change if needed.
Enter the delivery code to confirm receipt.
Report an issue if something does not match.
carrySteps: Post a trip with route, dates, and spare capacity.
Review delivery requests and accept parcels you can carry.
Pick up parcels at the sender handover point.
Update status as you travel and when ready for handover.
Complete delivery when the receiver confirms with their code.

safety.title: Safety & community rules
safety.prohibited: Do not send prohibited items — including flammables, weapons, illegal goods, perishable food without agreement, or anything that violates local law.
safety.tips: Meet in public handover points, verify parcel contents match the description, keep messages on-platform, and never share passwords or OTPs with strangers.

items.a: The demo shows sample routes between major cities. Real coverage will depend on active travelers on each corridor — we do not guarantee delivery to every address.
Quotes combine route distance, parcel weight and size, and optional services. Use the pricing estimator for a demo breakdown before you send.

items.q: Can one account send and carry?
items.a: Yes. Sending, receiving, and carrying are activities in the same account — switch between them anytime from the dashboard.

items.q: What if my parcel is delayed?
items.a: Travel times follow the posted trip window. Track status in the app and message the traveler. Use Support to report serious issues.

items.q: Are payments real in this demo?
items.a: No. Payment and payout screens use simulated data only. No money moves in the demo environment.
Traveler verification in the demo is a guided placeholder. Real identity checks would run through approved providers before go-live.
